body:
Founder real-time: iterate on REDGARDEN add some more items look into the GFD item database for inspiration bring in AD not just AP. Confirmed scope with the founder first: REDGARDEN's engine has no ability-power-scaling mechanic at all (every hero's Q/W/R deals flat hardcoded damage, unaffected by items), so this pass uses only existing stat fields -- GFD's real Attack/STR/DEX vs Magic Attack Bonus/INT/MND split translates onto REDGARDEN's existing bonus_ad vs bonus_max_mp/bonus_cdr_pct as the closest real caster analog, not a new damage stat. Five of the eight new items close a real, concrete gap found by directly counting the existing catalog: Body, Legs, Feet, Neck, and Waist each had exactly ONE item before this pass. Three are new flagship Weapon items including Excalibur, GFD's own single strongest item by a wide margin, now this catalog's new most powerful/expensive item too. New functional test (26 assertions) proves every new item's stat application, cross-slot stacking, and same-slot replacement -- caught and fixed one real bug before it shipped (Chain Leggings' armor bonus was missing from its own initializer, silently zero). go build and full test suite clean.

⚓ ☃
title: 8 new shop items (35 -> 43), inspired by GFD's real item database -- closes a real gap (5 of 11 slots had zero build choice)
